# Help Me Breathe

> A guided breathing timer with seven paced patterns, plus plain-language pages
> on each technique. The first three sessions are free; after that one plan,
> $10 a month or $100 a year. Written and maintained by one person, Georges
> Rayess, who is not a clinician. Claims are checked against the primary
> literature, quoted rather than paraphrased, and published next to the
> limitations of the study they came from.

Editorial stance: this site does not claim that breathing exercises treat any
condition. Where the evidence is one small trial, the page says so and gives the
sample size. Where there is no evidence, the page says there is none.

## Breathing techniques (one page and one working timer each)

- [Cyclic sighing](https://helpmebreath.com/cyclic-sighing): Double nasal inhale, long mouth exhale. The pattern from the Balban et al. 2023 Stanford trial (Cell Reports Medicine, PMID 36630953, NCT05304000).
- [4-7-8 breathing](https://helpmebreath.com/4-7-8-breathing): In 4, hold 7, out 8, a counted pattern popularised by Dr Andrew Weil. Canonical page for this technique.
- [Box breathing](https://helpmebreath.com/box-breathing): Four equal counts of four, including a hold at empty.
- [Heart coherence breathing](https://helpmebreath.com/heart-coherence-breathing): Six breaths a minute, no holds; the pace used in most HRV research.
- [Extended exhale breathing](https://helpmebreath.com/extended-exhale-breathing): In 4, out 6, nothing held. The gentlest starting pattern.
- [Triangle breathing](https://helpmebreath.com/triangle-breathing): Three counts of three. Used in classrooms and counselling rooms.
- [Energizing breath](https://helpmebreath.com/energizing-breath): Faster and rhythmic, for waking up. Carries a safety warning.

## Comparisons

- [Box breathing vs 4-7-8](https://helpmebreath.com/box-breathing-vs-4-7-8): Which to pick, with a difference table.
- [Breathing apps compared](https://helpmebreath.com/breathing-apps-compared): What breathing apps cost, what each free tier does, and when a plain pacer is enough. Prices checked 13 September 2026.
